brady_label.evidence: manual boundary on the temporal mean of all 28 vial-1 frames
brady_label.look: large white/gray wraparound paper with dense dark logo, text and barcode-like print

vial_13_80ml.evidence: fixed manual surface/foam band from the review's permitted calibration frames; pixel values are deterministic appearance proxies
vial_13_80ml.proxy_caveat: Foam, bubbles and specular reflection are not semantically labeled; these fractions and component counts are appearance proxies only.

vial_1_30ml.evidence: fixed manual surface/foam band from the review's permitted calibration frames; pixel values are deterministic appearance proxies
vial_1_30ml.proxy_caveat: Foam, bubbles and specular reflection are not semantically labeled; these fractions and component counts are appearance proxies only.

provenance.selection_rule: split each video's pinned camera index into videos.csv n_vials equal nominal cycles; gate paired 80% and 95% positions, then apply the logged settled proxy

tank_level_dye_colors.evidence: four fixed left-body ROIs avoid the central white level labels and metal; camera pixels are dye-colour anchors, not concentration measurements

renderer_dark_mix_proposal.evidence_label: proposal combining measured dye hues with observed dark-liquid values; not a physical dye-mixing calibration
renderer_dark_mix_proposal.hue_source: measured tank hue anchors plus measured settled vial hues

haze_proxy.wording: Physical haze is not identifiable from one camera view. Backdrop luma and local contrast are appearance proxies only.

labels.evidence: fixed vial-region pixel proxies on settled-proxy stills; not OCR or a label detector
labels.geometry_reference: Use the manually measured BRADY polygon from video-5 vial 1 for size, height and roll; these videos add look variation only.

settled_proxy.limitation: This rejects visible colored pours but cannot prove that clear liquid is motionless; non-passing selections are logged and excluded from appearance summaries.
settled_proxy.method: among 80% and 95% metadata-only candidates, reject candidates whose nozzle-to-vial corridor has more than 3% colored-stream pixels; prefer the strongest colored/dark liquid appearance, otherwise the later still

top_surface_and_foam.evidence: hue-compatible row-run top plus a fixed 16-pixel band; rows overlapping the holder are flagged instead of claimed visible
top_surface_and_foam.proxy_caveat: There are no semantic foam or bubble labels. Bright fractions and small components mix foam, bubbles, glare and compression artifacts.

haze_proxy.wording: Physical haze is not identifiable from one camera view. The backdrop luma floor and local robust contrast are appearance proxies only.

noise_proxy.method: 1.4826 times MAD of residual after Gaussian sigma 1.5 in backdrop ROI

other_real_frames_opened_definition: legacy video-5-only counter: no video-5 calibration or real-check frame outside the approved closed 98-frame vial-1/vial-13 set was opened; videos-1--4 appearance-reference counts are recorded separately

provenance.validation_order: index contract, paths and all 98 SHA-256 values pass before first decode

purpose: renderer-design evidence from permitted video-5 calibration frames and unlabeled appearance references in external videos 1-4

dark_liquid_top_surface.basis: calibration surface V medians near 0.172 and 0.217, vial-13 saturation near 0.105 and gray-reflective fraction near 0.893; external direct-surface V mean near 0.221 and p95 near 0.277
dark_liquid_top_surface.look: gray reflective oval with subdued liquid tint; include small liquid-tinted or gray foam patches and small surface bubbles

renderer_guidance.evidence_label: proposal derived from the measured ranges above; renderer settings, not additional physical measurements

labels.variation: large white/gray labels with dense dark print at varied heights and rolls

liquid.near_black: apply across hue families, not as one hue

training_policy: appearance measurements only; real frames are never model training data
